allOf.$comment: Conditional-required (T1 Evidence bundle shape): a pass OR fail verdict must carry reproductionCommand; a fail verdict must ALSO carry deltaFromContract. The 'then' subschemas re-declare the properties they require so the schema compiles cleanly under the repo's pinned ajv strict mode.

name.description: Join key: matches a criteria[].name in the corresponding sprint-{N}-contract.json.

deltaFromContract.description: expected paraphrases the criterion's description; observed is what the evaluator found.

reproductionCommand.description: A deterministic shell command a human can run to re-derive the verdict. Required for pass and fail verdicts; optional for blocked and skipped.

traceEventRefs.description: Array of <eventType>:<sequenceNumber> strings pointing into the run's trace. May be empty for verdict='skipped'.

description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the ClaudeAgents evaluator evidence bundle, v2 (T5). The bundle is the evaluator output artefact at .gan-state/runs/<run-id>/sprint-{N}-feedback-{attemptLetter}.json. v2 adds a required evaluatorPromptDigest field carrying the lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of agents/gan-evaluator.md, stamped by the orchestrator at evaluator spawn and forwarded by the evaluator into the emitted bundle. This is a breaking change vs v1 because the root schema declares additionalProperties: false, so a new required field cannot ride additively on v1. The v1 file is retained read-only for existing run dirs. Every other invariant (the per-criterion conditional-required logic, the join-key invariant on criteria[].name, the verdictSummary tallies) is preserved verbatim.

evaluatorPromptDigest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest (64 characters) of the agents/gan-evaluator.md file content as installed under ~/.claude/agents/, computed by the orchestrator at evaluator spawn and stamped on the bundle path. Required at root level; pinned by pattern so a non-hex or wrong-length value fails validation.

title: ClaudeAgents evaluator evidence bundle, v2
